pillar_reactions.evidence: Never delivered. The rep disqualified at 00:07:37 before any philosophy or offer walkthrough. The only product content on the call was the duration claim the prospect had already seen on social media — 'that's what we'll be getting to do. 30 minutes, 45 max' — offered as an aside rather than as a pillar. Notable because the prospect explicitly wanted movement variety and owns maces, which is the one piece of equipment overlap with the programme, and none of it was ever discussed.

Never delivered. The rep noted the prospect had 'a lot of things in place, nutrition-wise' and used that as grounds to disqualify rather than as a starting point. No mention of eating for health, micronutrients or sustainability. The prospect is a year into a supervised elimination protocol, which is either a strong reason the pillar is redundant or a strong reason it needs careful integration, and neither was explored.

Never delivered. No mention of Trevor, 24/7 support, weekly check-ins, form review or tracking. This is the notable omission of the call: the prospect described repeatedly failing to hold a line on his own — several attempts to moderate a kratom habit, cycles of burnout, six weeks of training lapsed during a move — which is precisely the problem the accountability pillar exists to solve, and it was never put in front of him.

anchors.raw: I do some meditation, and then I do like a nine-minute warm-up. And then I do, like, one round of, like, a five-round thing. It's kind of my ready-for-anything bare minimum thing that I do. And then I do the five Tibetan rites
anchors.note: The dominant anchor and an unusually strong one. He has built a comprehensive free system covering strength, conditioning, cardio, mobility and recovery, and it is demonstrably producing results — restored sleep, recovery scores in the nineties, triathlon training. The rep read this correctly and concluded he could not add enough value, which is a defensible call. The unexplored counter is that the prospect himself asked for variety and better effectiveness, so he does not believe his own system is optimal.

anchors.raw: I am doing a bit, but it is interesting to like have a different variety of things to do. And, you know, I, I'm picking up stuff on Instagram. So it's like, I'm doing all right.
anchors.competitor: Instagram fitness content, including the company's own
anchors.note: The third instance in this batch of the company's own free social content functioning as the primary competitor. He found the founder there, is programming from there, and is satisfied enough with the result to have abandoned the application halfway through.

anchors.raw: My Beam protocol specialist had me going outside, sitting in the sun for every meal.
anchors.note: He already pays for expert health guidance and follows it closely enough to restructure his meals around sun exposure. That is a demonstrated willingness to buy supervision, which sits oddly with a disqualification on the grounds that he has things handled — he has things handled because he bought help. Never surfaced or used.

anchors.raw: I've never seen anybody that only spends 20 to 30 minutes in the gym, or whatever, looking like that.
anchors.note: Not a price anchor but a value-integrity anchor, and the first of its kind in the corpus: the prospect doubts the advertised input produces the advertised output, with an unstated implication about how the founder actually looks that way. Until this is answerable with evidence, every prospect arriving from the same content carries the same unspoken question. Worth tracking whether it recurs.

unmet_demand.want: Movement variety and a more efficient, more effective use of the training time he already commits
unmet_demand.why_unmet: Not that the programme cannot do this — it is close to a precise description of what it sells. It went unmet because it was never presented. The rep moved from the training-week question straight to a fit challenge and then to disqualification, so the one thing the prospect actually asked for was never put in front of him.

unmet_demand.want: Credible evidence that the advertised 20 to 30 minutes a day produces the advertised physique
unmet_demand.why_unmet: Asked in substance in the first ninety seconds and never answered. No client results, no before-and-afters, no explanation of intensity versus duration. The same evidence request went unmet on the Peter Louis call the same day, where the prospect noted the material is not on the website either.

unmet_demand.want: Structure and external accountability to hold a line he has repeatedly failed to hold alone — several failed attempts to moderate a kratom habit, recurrent burnout, six weeks of lapsed training
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The accountability pillar was never presented, and the prospect's self-sufficiency in programming was read as self-sufficiency overall. Whether the offer would actually serve someone recovering from substance-related burnout is a separate and unexamined question, which is why this is recorded as unvalidated rather than as a positioning miss.
